title: If a routine's exercise details cannot be read, timed and distance exercises show as weight and reps and Swap disappears
what: The routine editor and the routine preview read each exercise's details after the routine loads. If that read fails, nothing is said: a plank or a run is shown with weight-and-reps sets, the line about timed or distance logging is wrong, and the Swap button for each exercise is hidden, so the member cannot swap and is not told why.
expected: A failed read says the routine details could not load, with Try again, instead of showing the wrong kind of sets and hiding Swap.
how_often: rarely, only when the phone's exercise read fails
fix_line: Treat a failed details read like a failed routine read: show the error with Try again, and keep a log line

title: If the 'Update your routine?' check fails at Finish, the question is simply never asked
what: Before saving a finished workout, the app works out whether the member changed their routine's weights, reps or exercises, so the summary can offer to update the routine. If that check fails, the failure is thrown away: the summary never asks, the routine keeps its old numbers, and the member is not told anything was skipped.
expected: A failed check is logged, and the summary says it could not compare with the routine (or retries the check), so the member can still update it.
how_often: rarely, only when that check fails
fix_line: Log the failure and let the summary say the routine could not be compared, with a way to update it anyway
